🧹 Basics

Data cleaning

In simple words

Finding and fixing mistakes in data, such as missing, wrong, repeated or impossible values, before a model learns from it.

The work of checking a dataset and fixing its problems before training: missing values, typos, duplicates, impossible numbers and wrong labels. A model can't tell a mistake from a fact, so “garbage in, garbage out”. Data scientists often spend more time cleaning data than building models.

Example. In a class survey, one student is “150” years old and one favourite pet is “dgo”. Cleaning fixes them to 15 and “dog” before training.

Related words

  • DataFacts and information a computer can store and use, such as numbers, words, pictures and clicks.
  • DatasetA large, organised collection of examples used to train or test an AI model.
  • LabelThe right answer attached to a training example, such as “cat” on a photo of a cat.
